# sharqey_service_account (Resource)

A Sharqey service account (machine identity for CI), scoped to a subgroup. Token-based auth only — see SHARQEY_SA_TOKEN/SHARQEY_SA_PRIVATE_KEY in `sharqey` CLI. There is no update API: any config change replaces the resource (new keypair, new token, old one revoked).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group` (String) Full path of the subgroup this service account is scoped to. Must NOT be an organization root — the server rejects that.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `role` (String) Role within the group: "viewer" (default) or "contributor".
- `ttl_days` (Number) Token lifetime in days (1-365, default 90 server-side). Only takes effect when the token is (re)created — changing it alone does not rotate an existing token, since it isn't a RequiresReplace attribute.

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (String) RFC3339 expiry of the token issued at creation time.
- `id` (String) Service account user UUID, assigned by the server.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) Armored OpenPGP private key generated locally for this service account, without passphrase. Use as SHARQEY_SA_PRIVATE_KEY. Never sent to the server.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Raw bearer token, returned once by the server at creation time. Use as SHARQEY_SA_TOKEN.
